title: decode.rs: full Base64 decode before max_bytes truncation
description: decode_body_value() (decode.rs lines 38-52, 71-73) allocates a stripped Vec<u8> by scanning every byte for CR/LF, then decodes the entire base64 body into a second Vec<u8>, then truncates to max_bytes. For a 10 MB attachment with max_bytes=256 this performs 7+ MB of work before discarding it. The same pattern applies to the QP path. Impact: callers that pass max_bytes for preview generation pay full decode cost regardless of the limit. Fix direction: decode and collect only up to max_bytes decoded output.
